description: Official electricity tariff (ElCom) for a Swiss commune and its grid operator(s): total, energy, grid use, commune charges and federal levy in Rappen per kWh, for 2025–2027, and the yearly bill for a consumption profile (ElCom categories H1–H8, default H4 = 5-room flat, 4500 kWh) or your own kWh.

commune.description: Swiss commune: official name, BFS number or 4-digit postcode, e.g. "Winterthur", "230" or "8400". «8001 Zürich» and «Basel (BS)» also work.

kwh.description: own yearly consumption (overrides the category volume)

year.description: Year of the ElCom tariff (2025 to 2027), e.g. 2026; omit for the latest. An unavailable year returns the list of available years.

name: get_electricity_price
title: Electricity tariff
